name: dataform
description: Canonical multimodal entities produced by data_ingestion.dataform. Nested names map directly to FieldRef.path in BQL AST v2.

fields.name: organization.envelope.source_id
fields.description: CourtListener court id: scotus, ca1..ca11, cadc, cafc, and lower-court ids such as texapp, cand, nysd. Use for exact court matches (org.envelope.source_id = 'ca9').

fields.name: organization.org_type
fields.description: court, agency, committee, firm, or party_entity.

fields.name: organization.name
fields.description: Court name, e.g. 'Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit', 'Supreme Court of the United States', 'Court of Criminal Appeals of Tennessee', 'Court of Chancery of Delaware'. To scope a search to a court, circuit or state: join document.proceeding_id -> proceeding.organization_id -> organization and use fuzzy() on this field, e.g. fuzzy(org.name, 'Ninth Circuit') or fuzzy(org.name, 'Texas').

fields.name: organization.short_name
fields.description: Abbreviated court name, e.g. 'Ninth Circuit', 'Supreme Court', 'E.D. California'.

fields.name: organization.jurisdiction
fields.description: Court-TYPE code: F federal appellate, FD federal district, FB federal bankruptcy, S state supreme, SA state appellate, ST state trial. It is NOT a state, circuit or place - never use it for 'Texas' or 'Ninth Circuit' (use organization.name).

fields.name: person.role_types
fields.description: Roles such as judge, legislator, attorney, party, or official.

fields.name: proceeding.title
fields.description: Case caption - party names only, e.g. 'Smith v. Jones'. It never carries subject matter: never use it for topics. Topical predicates belong on document.media.text.plain_text or document.summary.

fields.name: proceeding.organization_id
fields.description: The court (organization UUID) the case is before. Populated for every case; the way to reach a case's court.

fields.name: document.envelope.source_system
fields.description: Which ingestion source the record came from: courtlistener (opinions), oyez (oral_argument), ecfr (cfr_section), congress (bills), govinfo. Do NOT add a source_system filter unless the user asks for a specific source - doc_type is the discriminator (an oral_argument is source 'oyez', never 'courtlistener').

fields.name: document.doc_type
fields.description: opinion (5.4M court opinions), oral_argument (6.7k Supreme Court arguments with audio + transcript), cfr_section (229k), bill (41k), statute, federal_register_notice, other. For 'cases about X' prefer opinion and/or oral_argument.

fields.name: document.title
fields.description: Case name for opinions (e.g. 'Copley v. Brander'); section heading for CFR; 'Oral Argument - <date>' for oral arguments (their case name is on the linked proceeding.title).

fields.name: document.citation
fields.description: Canonical reporter citation of the opinion, e.g. '490 U.S. 386' (indexed). Use exact equality to find a specific reported case.

fields.name: document.jurisdiction
fields.description: CourtListener court id of the court that issued the document - the FASTEST way to scope by court (indexed). Examples: scotus, ca1..ca11 (federal circuits), cadc, cafc, cand / nysd (district courts), texapp, illappct, delch (Delaware Chancery), haw. Use exact equality, e.g. doc.jurisdiction = 'ca9' for 'Ninth Circuit'. For a state ('Texas courts') prefer the organization join with fuzzy(org.name, 'Texas').

fields.name: document.issuing_body_id
fields.description: Organization UUID of the issuing court (indexed). Joins directly to organization.envelope.id, so a court name can be matched with fuzzy(org.name, ...) in one hop.

fields.name: document.date_issued
fields.description: Date the opinion was issued / the argument was heard. Populated for every opinion.

fields.name: document.summary
fields.description: Syllabus / headnotes / procedural posture / disposition of an opinion (present for a growing share of opinions). Good for topical fuzzy() predicates when the question is about what a case held.

fields.name: document.media.text.plain_text
fields.description: The document's text: the opinion body, or for doc_type = 'oral_argument' the full transcript of the Supreme Court argument. The preferred field for topical fuzzy() predicates about what a case discusses.

fields.name: document.media.audio
fields.description: Audio recordings and time-aligned transcript data.

fields.name: citation.envelope.id
fields.description: EMPTY in the current corpus: the citation table has no rows. Do not join to citation - any query requiring it returns nothing.

fields.name: citation.citing_document_id
fields.description: EMPTY in the current corpus. Do not use.

fields.name: citation.cited_document_id
fields.description: EMPTY in the current corpus. Do not use.

fields.name: citation.citation_string
fields.description: EMPTY in the current corpus. Do not use.

fields.name: citation.treatment
fields.description: EMPTY in the current corpus. Do not use.

fields.name: event.event_type
fields.description: Docket entry, vote, hearing, filing, or action.
